```{r echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# Load data
sal <- read_csv(paste0(
  "https://stat.cmu.edu/~sgallagh/courses/mads-fall-2026/",
  "datavis-36613/data/salaries.csv.gz"
))
```

```{r echo = FALSE}
sal <- sal |>
  mutate(
    experience_level = factor(
      experience_level,
      levels = c("EX", "SE", "MI", "EN"),
      labels = c("Executive", "Senior", "Mid", "Entry")
    ),
    
    remote = case_when(
      remote_ratio == 0 ~ "On-Site",
      remote_ratio == 50 ~ "Hybrid",
      remote_ratio == 100 ~ "Fully remote"
    ),
    
    remote = factor(
      remote,
      levels = c("On-Site", "Hybrid", "Fully remote")
    ),
    
    log_salary = log(salary_in_usd)
  ) |>
  filter(employment_type == "FT")
```

```{r echo = FALSE}
sal <- sal |>
  mutate(
    role_group = case_when(

      # Data Science
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "data scientist|decision scientist|applied scientist"
      ) ~ "Data Science",

      # AI / Machine Learning
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "machine learning|\\bml\\b|artificial intelligence|\\bai\\b|nlp|computer vision|deep learning|llm|prompt"
      ) ~ "AI / Machine Learning",

      # Data Engineering / Infrastructure
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "data engineer|data architect|dataops|data infrastructure|data platform|data integration|etl|data pipeline|data developer"
      ) ~ "Data Engineering / Infrastructure",

      # Analytics / BI
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "analyst|analytics|business intelligence|\\bbi\\b|power bi|data analysis|reporting|data visualization"
      ) ~ "Analytics / BI",

      # Research / Quantitative
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "research|quantitative|statistician|statistical|computational scientist|economist|actuar|postdoctoral"
      ) ~ "Research / Quantitative",

      # Management / Product
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "manager|director|head of|product manager|product owner|data lead|analytics lead"
      ) ~ "Management / Product",

      # Software / Systems Engineering
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "software|developer|engineer|devops|platform|site reliability|systems|system engineer|architect|technical lead|tech lead"
      ) ~ "Software / Systems Engineering",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )
```







```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Dashboard styling
# --------------------------------------------------

cat('
<style>
body {
  background: #F3F6F5;
  color: #193E30;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
}

#quarto-content {
  max-width: 1450px;
  margin: auto;
}

#title-block-header {
  display: none;
}

.dashboard-header {
  background: #194735;
  color: white;
  padding: 34px 42px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin: 20px 0 24px;
}

.dashboard-eyebrow {
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.dashboard-header h1 {
  color: white;
  font-size: 34px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}

.dashboard-header p {
  color: #D7E8DE;
  font-size: 16px;
  margin: 0;
}

.dashboard-panel {
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #E0E8E2;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(25, 71, 53, 0.04);
}

.dashboard-section-title {
  color: #194735;
  font-size: 23px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.dashboard-note {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #63756B;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.dashboard-footer {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #63756B;
  margin: 18px 0 32px;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .dashboard-header {
    padding: 24px;
  }

  .dashboard-header h1 {
    font-size: 25px;
  }

  .dashboard-panel {
    padding: 12px;
  }
}
</style>
')

cat('
<div class="dashboard-header">
  <h1>Data & AI Workforce Compensation Explorer</h1>
  <p>
    Explore salary trends across experience levels,
    company sizes, and technical role groups.
  </p>
</div>
')

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare data
# --------------------------------------------------

levels_exp <- c("Entry", "Mid", "Senior", "Executive")

sizes <- c(
  "All Companies",
  "Small",
  "Medium",
  "Large"
)

roles <- c(
  "All Roles",
  "Data Science",
  "AI / Machine Learning",
  "Data Engineering / Infrastructure",
  "Analytics / BI",
  "Research / Quantitative",
  "Management / Product",
  "Software / Systems Engineering",
  "Other"
)

salary_data <- sal |>
  mutate(
    experience_level = factor(
      as.character(experience_level),
      levels = levels_exp
    ),
    company_size = recode(
      as.character(company_size),
      S = "Small",
      M = "Medium",
      L = "Large"
    ),
    role_group = as.character(role_group)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(experience_level),
    !is.na(company_size),
    !is.na(role_group)
  )

salary_options <- bind_rows(
  salary_data,
  salary_data |>
    mutate(company_size = "All Companies"),
  salary_data |>
    mutate(role_group = "All Roles"),
  salary_data |>
    mutate(
      company_size = "All Companies",
      role_group = "All Roles"
    )
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Annual salary progression
# --------------------------------------------------

career_plot <- salary_options |>
  filter(!is.na(salary_in_usd)) |>
  group_by(
    role_group,
    company_size,
    work_year,
    experience_level
  ) |>
  summarise(
    median_salary = median(salary_in_usd),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 5)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Salary premium calculations
# --------------------------------------------------

career_gains <- salary_options |>
  filter(
    work_year %in% c(2024, 2025),
    !is.na(salary_in_usd)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    role_group,
    company_size,
    experience_level
  ) |>
  summarise(
    median_salary = median(salary_in_usd),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    median_salary = if_else(
      n >= 5,
      median_salary,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = experience_level,
    values_from = median_salary
  )

for (level in levels_exp) {
  if (!level %in% names(career_gains)) {
    career_gains[[level]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

career_gains <- career_gains |>
  mutate(
    Entry_Mid = (Mid - Entry) / Entry,
    Mid_Senior = (Senior - Mid) / Mid,
    Senior_Executive = (Executive - Senior) / Senior
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Formatting
# --------------------------------------------------

colors <- c(
  Entry = "#168B78",
  Mid = "#DF742D",
  Senior = "#416FB9",
  Executive = "#8752AA"
)

dash_styles <- c(
  Entry = "solid",
  Mid = "dash",
  Senior = "dot",
  Executive = "dashdot"
)

symbols <- c(
  Entry = "circle",
  Mid = "square",
  Senior = "diamond",
  Executive = "triangle-up"
)

navy <- "#193E30"
muted <- "#63756B"

format_salary <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "N/A",
    dollar(x, accuracy = 1)
  )
}

format_gain <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x) | !is.finite(x),
    "N/A",
    percent(x, accuracy = 0.1)
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plotly line traces
# --------------------------------------------------

fig <- plot_ly()

trace_roles <- character()
trace_sizes <- character()
trace_levels <- character()
trace_types <- character()

for (role in roles) {
  for (size in sizes) {
    for (level in levels_exp) {

      df <- career_plot |>
        filter(
          role_group == role,
          company_size == size,
          experience_level == level
        ) |>
        arrange(work_year)

      if (nrow(df) == 0) next

      initial <- (
        role == "All Roles" &&
        size == "All Companies"
      )

      fig <- fig |>
        add_trace(
          data = df,
          x = ~work_year,
          y = ~median_salary,
          type = "scatter",
          mode = "lines+markers",
          name = paste(level, "Level"),
          legendgroup = level,
          visible = initial,
          showlegend = initial,

          line = list(
            color = colors[[level]],
            width = 5,
            dash = dash_styles[[level]]
          ),

          marker = list(
            color = colors[[level]],
            symbol = symbols[[level]],
            size = 8
          ),

          text = ~paste0(
            "<b>Year:</b> ", work_year,
            "<br><b>Role group:</b> ", role_group,
            "<br><b>Company size:</b> ", company_size,
            "<br><b>Experience:</b> ", experience_level,
            "<br><b>Median salary:</b> ",
            dollar(median_salary),
            "<br><b>Records:</b> ", comma(n)
          ),

          hoverinfo = "text"
        )

      trace_roles <- c(trace_roles, role)
      trace_sizes <- c(trace_sizes, size)
      trace_levels <- c(trace_levels, level)
      trace_types <- c(trace_types, "line")
    }
  }
}

fig <- plotly_build(fig)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Table traces
# --------------------------------------------------

for (role in roles) {
  for (size in sizes) {

    df <- career_gains |>
      filter(
        role_group == role,
        if (size == "All Companies") {
          company_size %in% c("Small", "Medium", "Large")
        } else {
          company_size == size
        }
      ) |>
      arrange(match(company_size, sizes))

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      df <- tibble(
        company_size = if (size == "All Companies") {
          c("Small", "Medium", "Large")
        } else {
          size
        },
        Entry = NA_real_,
        Mid = NA_real_,
        Senior = NA_real_,
        Executive = NA_real_,
        Entry_Mid = NA_real_,
        Mid_Senior = NA_real_,
        Senior_Executive = NA_real_
      )
    }

    row_colors <- rep(
      c("#FFFFFF", "#F0F4F1"),
      length.out = nrow(df)
    )

    initial <- (
      role == "All Roles" &&
      size == "All Companies"
    )

    fig <- fig |>
      add_trace(
        type = "table",
        inherit = FALSE,

        domain = list(
          x = c(0, 1),
          y = c(0.10, 0.32)
        ),

        header = list(
          values = c(
            "<b>Company<br>Size</b>",
            "<b>Entry<br>Level</b>",
            "<b>Mid<br>Level</b>",
            "<b>Senior<br>Level</b>",
            "<b>Executive<br>Level</b>",
            "<b>Entry to<br>Mid (%)</b>",
            "<b>Mid to<br>Senior (%)</b>",
            "<b>Senior to<br>Executive (%)</b>"
          ),
          align = "center",
          fill = list(color = "#194735"),
          font = list(
            color = "#FFFFFF",
            size = 12
          ),
          line = list(color = "#DCE7DF"),
          height = 48
        ),

        cells = list(
          values = list(
            as.character(df$company_size),
            format_salary(df$Entry),
            format_salary(df$Mid),
            format_salary(df$Senior),
            format_salary(df$Executive),
            format_gain(df$Entry_Mid),
            format_gain(df$Mid_Senior),
            format_gain(df$Senior_Executive)
          ),

          align = "center",
          fill = list(
            color = rep(list(row_colors), 8)
          ),
          font = list(
            color = navy,
            size = 12
          ),
          line = list(color = "#DCE7DF"),
          height = 37
        ),

        visible = initial,
        showlegend = FALSE
      )

    trace_roles <- c(trace_roles, role)
    trace_sizes <- c(trace_sizes, size)
    trace_levels <- c(trace_levels, "")
    trace_types <- c(trace_types, "table")
  }
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Dropdown buttons
# --------------------------------------------------

size_buttons <- lapply(sizes, function(size) {
  list(
    label = size,
    method = "skip"
  )
})

role_buttons <- lapply(roles, function(role) {
  list(
    label = role,
    method = "skip"
  )
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Plotly layout
# --------------------------------------------------

fig <- fig |>
  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
    plot_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",

    font = list(
      family = "Arial, sans-serif",
      color = navy,
      size = 13
    ),

    title = list(
      text = "<b>Median Annual Salary by Experience Level</b>",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      font = list(
        size = 23,
        color = navy
      )
    ),

    xaxis = list(
      title = list(text = "Year"),
      range = c(2019.8, 2025.2),
      tickmode = "linear",
      tick0 = 2020,
      dtick = 1,
      domain = c(0.05, 0.82),
      showgrid = FALSE,
      zeroline = FALSE,
      linecolor = "#CBD5E1"
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title = list(
        text = "Median Annual Salary (USD)"
      ),
      domain = c(0.49, 0.89),
      rangemode = "tozero",
      tickprefix = "$",
      tickformat = ",.0f",
      showgrid = TRUE,
      gridcolor = "#E7EDF5",
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),

    legend = list(
      x = 0.84,
      y = 0.82,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0)"
    ),

    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        buttons = size_buttons,
        direction = "down",
        x = 0.05,
        y = 1.02,
        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "top",
        showactive = TRUE,
        bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
        bordercolor = "#CBD8D1"
      ),

      list(
        buttons = role_buttons,
        direction = "down",
        x = 0.28,
        y = 1.02,
        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "top",
        showactive = TRUE,
        bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
        bordercolor = "#CBD8D1"
      )
    ),

    annotations = list(
      list(
        text = "<b>COMPANY SIZE</b>",
        x = 0.05,
        y = 1.04,
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        xanchor = "left",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 12, color = muted)
      ),

      list(
        text = "<b>ROLE GROUP</b>",
        x = 0.28,
        y = 1.04,
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        xanchor = "left",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 12, color = muted)
      ),

      list(
        text = paste0(
          "Median annual salary in USD | ",
          "Minimum 5 records per plotted point"
        ),
        x = 0.05,
        y = 0.92,
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        xanchor = "left",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 14, color = muted)
      ),

      list(
        text = "<b>Salary Comparison and Career-Stage Premiums</b>",
        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.37,
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 21, color = navy)
      ),

      list(
        text = "2024–2025 pooled salary medians",
        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.33,
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 14, color = muted)
      )
    ),

    height = 1100,
    autosize = TRUE,

    margin = list(
      t = 115,
      b = 40,
      l = 100,
      r = 35
    ),

    hovermode = "closest"
  ) |>
  config(
    responsive = TRUE,
    displaylogo = FALSE,
    displayModeBar = "hover"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 10. Interactive filters and dynamic statistics
# --------------------------------------------------

trace_info <- list(
  roles = trace_roles,
  sizes = trace_sizes,
  levels = trace_levels,
  types = trace_types
)

summary_data <- career_gains |>
  filter(company_size %in% sizes) |>
  mutate(
    key = paste(role_group, company_size, sep = "||"),
    senior_salary = Senior,
    senior_premium = Mid_Senior
  ) |>
  select(key, senior_salary, senior_premium)

js <- sprintf(
"
function(el, x) {

  var gd = el;
  var info = %s;
  var summaries = %s;
  var sizeOptions = %s;

  var selectedSize = 'All Companies';
  var selectedRole = 'All Roles';

  gd.on('plotly_buttonclicked', function(event) {

    var label = event.button.label;

    if (sizeOptions.indexOf(label) !== -1) {
      selectedSize = label;
    } else {
      selectedRole = label;
    }

    var visible = [];
    var showlegend = [];
    var shownLevels = {};

    for (var i = 0; i < info.roles.length; i++) {

      var matches =
        info.roles[i] === selectedRole &&
        info.sizes[i] === selectedSize;

      visible.push(matches);

      var legend = false;

      if (matches && info.types[i] === 'line') {

        var level = info.levels[i];

        if (!shownLevels[level]) {
          legend = true;
          shownLevels[level] = true;
        }
      }

      showlegend.push(legend);
    }

    Plotly.restyle(gd, {
      visible: visible,
      showlegend: showlegend
    });

    var key = selectedRole + '||' + selectedSize;

    var row = summaries.find(function(d) {
      return d.key === key;
    });

    if (row) {

      var salary = row.senior_salary;
      var premium = row.senior_premium;

      var salaryText =
        salary == null || !Number.isFinite(salary)
        ? 'N/A'
        : '$' + Math.round(salary).toLocaleString('en-US');

      var premiumText =
        premium == null || !Number.isFinite(premium)
        ? 'N/A'
        : (premium * 100).toFixed(1) + '%%';

      var salaryEl = document.getElementById('senior-salary');
      var premiumEl = document.getElementById('senior-premium');

      if (salaryEl) salaryEl.textContent = salaryText;
      if (premiumEl) premiumEl.textContent = premiumText;
    }
  });
}
",
  jsonlite::toJSON(trace_info, auto_unbox = TRUE),
  jsonlite::toJSON(summary_data, dataframe = "rows", na = "null"),
  jsonlite::toJSON(sizes, auto_unbox = TRUE)
)

fig <- htmlwidgets::onRender(fig, js)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 11. Render dashboard
# --------------------------------------------------

fig
```
